title: Glyph
tagline: We are creating an Dapp for people to  mint the papers / scientific ideas  ( as an way to  support the author and references ) and then using the merkle distributor mechanism to pay to all the contributors  , the proceeds of the bid of that given token
description: we are using the splitter  payment type  , being already used at large scale payment of the airdrops ( by uniswap for instance  and mirror.xyz) to evolve the project to allow consequent stakeholders of the  scientific papers (reference citations , co-authors , etc) being able to be  sponsored for the paper research , by allowing anybody to  create NFT tokens of  these details  , and then allow the auctioning of the token to create the  liquidity  pool , which is then being redeemed to the given users
how_its_made: this project is currently incomplete , but the potential work in the future is follows : this project uses the web3.storage to first get the users input (which will be  defined as the users  metadata and that of the manuscript NFT token ), who wants to register his paper .  then we will generate the CID for the details for the splitter contract to be accessing the details about the authors (create new  addresses if they are not present , else integrating their ENS names ) , and then  disbursing them the payments based on their defines %  to each of the person who has  being referenced in the paper.
